details.title: Isolated DC/DC power stage
details.description: The isolated DC/DC power stage converts the boosted DC voltage at the PFC output into an isolated low voltage CC/CV controlled output required for charging the battery. Efficiency is a key parameter for this stage as it needs to contain protection mechanisms for over current and over temperature.

details.title: Auxiliary power supply
details.description: Auxiliary power supply generally consists of a low power high voltage DC/DC converter for developing multiple isolated or non-isolated rails used to power various subsystems in the end equipment such as PWM controllers, gate drivers, sense and feedback components and in some cases a FAN. It can be made of multiple stages where the output from the main DC/DC converter could be fed to further low voltage DC/DC converters or LDOs. A typical aspect of the auxiliary power supply is its low standby power which is important in improving overall system efficiency.
